about.boards: per board directory of records/crc (records_dir): id (the board's id in libs.json and in kinds/crc/repeat.sh), the record's board, board_decoded, core and clock_hz; note_cache_off: the sentence the results page puts above the board's cache-off tables (site/crc_tables.py, BEFORE_OFF), or null
about.crcs: the CRCs in the order of kinds/crc/configs.txt
about.configurations: per adapter, in the order of kinds/crc/configs.txt: its language (column 2: C, C++ or Rust) and library (column 3), the name the record carries, its CRC, and class and table place (step 2 of kinds/crc/README.md, as site/crc_tables.py reads it)
about.rows: per board and configuration: flash_bytes (the table in flash plus the code at -O2 for the board's core) and ram_bytes (step 4 of kinds/crc/README.md, as site/crc_tables.py), the record's path, cycles and per_byte
about.baseline: per board and CRC: the reference of that CRC, timed in the same images (the records' baseline), cycles and per_byte over all images of the board's configurations of that CRC
about.cycles: cycles[cache][offset][length]: [min, max] over the eight placements, first pass, of the mean of the scenario's 256 calls (the first call included), in cycles; cache on/off, offset 0 (an 8-byte boundary) or 1, length 1 to 1024 bytes (the record's results, len<N>/offset<K>/cache_<off|on>)
about.per_byte: per_byte[cache][offset]: [min, max] over the eight placements, first pass, of (mean at 1024 bytes - mean at 256 bytes) / 768
about.ranges: a difference between two rows is a difference only where their ranges do not overlap (DECISIONS 2026-11-25); the rows are in the order of kinds/crc/configs.txt, not ranked
about.not_here: the second pass and the minimum, maximum and first call of each scenario: in the records
